fichas.title: Daylight quality criteria
fichas.summary: Explains how illuminance, surface reflectance, colour, daylight uniformity, glare control and shadow formation affect interior daylight quality. Diagrams compare side-window and rooflight illumination and show the influence of daylight openings. A staggered, multilayered transparent transition between interior and exterior can help meet changing seasonal daylight requirements.
uses: Set illuminance and surface-reflectance criteria for visual tasks
